title: Servicii integrate de inginerie
description:
Servicii diverse de inginerie geodezica. Masuratori terestre realizate cu tehnologie GNSS si Statii totala; - Asigurare consultanta in privinta lucrarilor de cadastru funciar; - Asigurarea in permanenta in cadrul institutiei de Luni pana Vineri in intervalul orar 8-16 a minim DOI ingineri; - Asigurarea permanenta a unui Aparat GPS (Ce poate masura RTK, VRS); - Asigurarea permanenta a unui Aparat Statie Totala; - Asigurarea unui mijloc de transport necesar la deplasari in teren; - Deplasare la sedintele OCPI, Prefectura si alte institutii ce au ca subiect probleme de fond funciar; - Intocmirea unui sistem de organizare eficient a activitatii de Cadastru; - Pastrarea si dezvoltarea bazei de date a biroului de cadastru; - Eliberarea adeverintelor privitoare la situatia juridica a imobilelor; - Eliberarea adreselor catre proprietari ce au solicitari legate de fond funciar; - Eliberarea adreselor catre proprietari ce au probleme de vecinatate cu domeniul public; - Eliberarea extraselor de plan parcelar si a altor schite privitoare la planurile parcelare; - Eliberarea incadrarilor in zona, la scara corespunzatoare; - Intocmirea hartilor si planurilor utile in cadrul institutiei pentru diverse activitati; - Solicitarea informatiilor necesare de la OCPI Ilfov privitor la dosarele de cadastru; - Actualizarea informatiilor cu imobilele inregistrate in sistemul Eterra; - Actualizarea hartilor cu PUZ-uri aprobate, dupa fiecare sedinta; - Actualizarea hartilor cu drumurile dobandite.

title: ERS TESTBED ARCHITECTURE DEFINITION ACTIVITY AND TESTBED DEPLOYMENT AND EVOLUTION ACTIVITY
description: The proposed procurement covers the definition, deployment, operation and evolution of a ERSEO Element 1 Testbed, a sovereign, scalable, secure, capacity-building digital environment enabling the deployment and extensive testing of diverse vertical, resilience-oriented applications and enabling tools (i.e. the Proof-of-Concepts , PoCs).The Testbed is a key enabling element of the Element 1 Proof-of-Concept component providing a common, high-performance deployment and testing environment to maximise synergies and efficiency across PoCs. While the PoCs themselves will be procured under specific procurement actions and are outside the scope of the present procurement, ESA will ensure an optimised allocation and sharing of responsibilities between the Testbed contractor and the PoCsdevelopers, in line with their respective competences and roles.Key activities covered by the Procurement are: (1) Testbed architecture definition, (2) Testbed deployment, operation and evolution, (3) PoCs deployment and testing, (4) Validation of the set-up under representative conditions, (5) Production and maintenance of architecture blueprint and reference artefacts to support PoCs portability, scalability and procurement de-risking.The procurement will be conducted through a single Invitation to Tender with the objective of maximising synergies between the testbed architecture definition and the subsequent deployment of the testbed. The ITT will lead to a phased procurement approach with a contractual breakpoint between Phase 1 and Phase 2.

title: Propellant Tank
description: The Gateway is a multi-element infrastructure designed to support both robotic and human exploration of cis-lunar space and act as a ‘basecamp’ for sustained lunar exploration. The Lunar Gateway is smaller than the ISS and will require less launches for its assembly. It is intended to be occupied by a crew of up to four astronauts for periods ranging from two weeks to two months, but otherwise operates as a robotic spacecraft. The Gateway – European System Providing Refueling Infrastructure and Telecommunication (ESPRIT) is ESA’s c ontribution of an infrastructure element supporting the Gateway with refueling, logistic and telecommunication functions (this latter function will be provided with a different element that will reach Gateway at a different time). The ESPRIT includes contributions from USA, and Canada. Thales Alenia Space UK as a core team member, and Thales Alenia Space France, prime contractor for the programme, have been contracted by the European Space Agency (ESA) for the realization of the ESPRIT module for the new Lunar Orbital Platform Gateway. Under a subcontract, Thales Alenia Space UK is responsible for the Bi-Propellant Transfer system (BTS), a system refuelling the chemical propulsion system of the Lunar Gateway. The objective of the present procurement is the selection of the subcontractor for the Propellant Tank in the subsystem in propellant transfer, pressurisation and venting operations. The procurement of the Propellant Tank will be conducted in line with the “ESA Best Practices for the Selection of Subcontractors by Prime Contractors in the frame of ESA’s Major Procurements” (reference ESA BEST PRACTICES IPC(2012)65, rev.2). Further information concerning the ESPRIT campaign can be found on the Agency´s website here: https://www.esa.int/Science_Exploration/Human_and_Robotic_Exploration/Gateway_to_the_Moon. Notwithstanding the complete list of countries identified in the Special Provision for visibility purposes, the ITT letter of invitation will contain a dedicated set of geographical return requirements/targets to be considered

description: De gemeente Schouwen-Duiveland wil een raamovereenkomst met één opdrachtnemer afsluiten met een looptijd van twee jaar met twee verlengopties van één jaar voor de uitvoering van werkzaamheden in het kader van het onderhoud aan het rioolstelsel in de gemeente Schouwen-Duiveland. De werkzaamheden betreffen: a. Opstellen deelopdrachten; b. Reinigen riolering; c. Inspecteren riolering; d. Bijkomende werkzaamheden. De raming van de opdracht (looptijd 4 jaar) wordt door de Aanbestedende dienst geschat op € 800.000,-. Aan deze raming kunnen geen rechten worden ontleend. De Aanbestedende dienst is op basis van jurisprudentie (arrest ECLI:EU:C:2018:1034) verplicht om een maximale opdrachtwaarde op te nemen. De maximale opdrachtwaarde over de gehele looptijd inclusief verlengopties van de raamovereenkomst wordt vastgesteld op € 1.600.000,- inclusief prijsindexaties, exclusief BTW. Gezien de onvoorspelbaarheid van de omvang van de toekomstige behoefte aan deze dienstverlening wordt de marge van tweemaal het geraamde bedrag genomen. Indien binnen de contractduur van Raamovereenkomst (maximaal 4 jaar) de maximale opdrachtwaarde van € 1.600.000,- inclusief prijsindexaties, exclusief BTW. wordt bereikt, zal de Raamovereenkomst met de opdrachtnemer bij het bereiken van voornoemde maximale opdrachtwaarde omvang eindigen en verstrekt de Aanbestedende dienst in dat geval geen nadere opdrachten meer, waarbij de Opdrachtnemer ter zake geen aanspraak kan maken op schadevergoeding op welke grond dan ook.

title: FIRST! - INNOVATIVE MECHANICAL JOINING TECHNOLOGIES FOR METALLIC AND COMPOSITE STRUCTURES - EXPRO+
description: Space Transportation vehicle structures being manufactured and built in separate parts, joining techniques have been highly used inthe last decades. When added-up, these joins can induce significant mass penalties as well as assembly times and costs that could be reduced with smarter concepts. Moreover, with the fast progress of CFRP, advanced manufacturing and enhanced metallic alloys for structures, the need of new techniques to join these different materials is more and more acute. New joining technologies are needed to join composite parts, and composite/metallic parts. These joining technologies shall be light weight and low cost and they also have to be easy to manufacture, control and maintain.
